Every fixed prefix of a hypothetical global minimum over all positive nonperiodic sources, not every arbitrary target

exact_scope.completeness: Finite query coverage is explicit. Each valid potential separately proves an all-length statement by global extension, not finite extrapolation. Resource limits return UNKNOWN. No universal search termination or certificate-size bound is asserted.

A separate forward-closed graph, first-hit coefficients and contracting positive cycles for every candidate source
Pascal-row capacities instead of generator binomial/Fraction arithmetic; exact dependency hashes and rational comparisons

stop_conditions: A timeout is UNKNOWN, never a no-improvement certificate.
Repair any omitted upper envelope, positive-source, cycle or outside-W edge before acceptance.

interpretation_boundary: Old bounded Phase 41 mode is unchanged.
No new external theorem is used; E46 and E54 remain explicitly inherited finite inputs.
703 is a finite monotonicity falsifier, not an infinite geodesic or a Collatz counterexample.
